ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the food web shown in the illustration, two primary consumers are _____ and _____.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: the diagram is a soil food web. The left side shows the plant's shoots & roots, and below there is organic matter labeled ORGANIC MATTER, explaining that it is composed of waste, residue, and metabolites of plants, animals, and microbes. In the diagram, red arrows are used to show the direction of food flow; from the organic matter/plant residue base part on the left side, it can be seen that arrows point directly to BACTERIA, and there are also arrows pointing directly to EARTHWORMS. Reasoning: the question asks for the two primary consumers in the illustrated food web. According to the diagram and method, primary consumers are organisms that directly eat producers or basic organic matter. Because in the diagram organic matter directly supplies bacteria and earthworms, the two primary consumers are bacteria and earthworm.
